title: 3579. Minimum Steps to Convert String with Operations

examples.explanation: Divide word1 into "ab", "c", and "df". The operations are: For the substring "ab", Perform operation of type 3 on "ab" -> "ba". Perform operation of type 1 on "ba" -> "da". For the substring "c" do no operations. For the substring "df", Perform operation of type 1 on "df" -> "bf". Perform operation of type 1 on "bf" -> "be".

Divide word1 into "ab", "ce", and "ded". The operations are: For the substring "ab", Perform operation of type 2 on "ab" -> "ba". For the substring "ce", Perform operation of type 2 on "ce" -> "ec". For the substring "ded", Perform operation of type 1 on "ded" -> "fed". Perform operation of type 1 on "fed" -> "fef".
Divide word1 into "abcdef". The operations are: For the substring "abcdef", Perform operation of type 3 on "abcdef" -> "fedcba". Perform operation of type 2 on "fedcba" -> "fedabc".
